narrative: Material PL1__M4716C03 exhibits lumpy demand with normal distribution characteristics (CV=0.38) across 93 working days. Lead time is moderately variable (CV=0.376) with a bimodal pattern suggesting two transport modes; the dominant risk driver is transport (60% of variance). The optimised (r,Q) policy reduces safety stock by 256 units to 1,447 — sufficient for 95% service level — and recommends reducing the SAP safety lead time from 5.0 to 3.37 days based on observed effective lead time.

research_insights.selected_model: (r, Q) continuous-review with Normal lead-time demand approximation
research_insights.selection_rationale: CV=0.38 and 100% non-zero demand fraction fully support the Normal parametric (r,Q) model. Demand is continuous with moderate variability — no intermittency or heavy tails requiring non-parametric treatment.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Low — post-replenishment stock (1,447 + 19,496 = 20,943 units) is well within the 44,671-unit storage limit, leaving a 23,728-unit margin.
research_insights.escalation_flag: None — MOQ (953) + Safety Stock (1,447) = 2,400 units, far below max_storage_units (44,671). No infeasibility.
